rows.何時用: 大部分觀察、吐槽、探索評論
rows.例: 「Dead Man's Drink. Charming name.」「I wonder what happened here.」
「I'm glad you're here with me.」「You made the world a better place... for me.」
「even me and my mother... we just became clutter.」「I just can't help feeling bad about... the way things are.」

rows.何時用: 被當工具、被自以為是地論斷、戰鬥
rows.例: 「Am I a dreadful evil who needs to be purged...?」「There you are, father!」
「I almost thought I lost you for a bit there.」「Unh... where is... who sent you here?」（剛醒來的脆弱）
「my father's not exactly a good person. Even by vampire standards.」
